logo_rules: Use the wordmark in Charcoal on light backgrounds, Oat on dark
Keep clear space equal to the height of the 'L' on all sides
Never stretch, recolour or add effects to the wordmark
guidelines.tone_of_voice: Calm, tactile and unhurried. Speaks about materials and craft, never about trends.
dos: Name the fibre in the copy (linen, wool, cotton)
donts: No heavy retouching of skin or fabric
mandatory_legal_lines: Loomhouse is a trading name of Loomhouse Ltd.

logo_rules: Use the stride mark with the wordmark except on product, where the mark stands alone
Never place the logo over busy crowd shots
guidelines.tone_of_voice: Direct, energetic and encouraging. Short sentences, active verbs, talks to every runner not just athletes.
dos: Show real runners in real city streets
Lead with movement in the first second of video
Credit the shoe model by name
donts: No performance claims without a source
No shaming language about bodies or pace

logo_rules: Use the leaf mark in Fern or white only
Keep the logo in the top or bottom left corner
guidelines.tone_of_voice: Warm, clear and science-backed. Explains ingredients simply and never overpromises.
dos: Show skin as it is, with texture
Include the product on a natural surface
donts: No medical claims such as 'cures' or 'treats'
